question: After allowing a discount of 11% on the marked price of an article, it is sold for ₹41,207. Find its marked price (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price (SP) = 100% − 11% Discount = 89% of Marked Price (MP)

Given SP = ₹41,207

89% of MP = 41207

MP = (41207 ÷ 89) × 100

MP = 463 × 100 = 46300

**∴ Answer = 46300**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹41,207

Discount percentage = 11%

**Formula used:**

Marked Price (MP) = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 − Discount%)

 Marked Price (100%) = ? SP = 89% (₹41,207) 11% Disc 
• MP = ₹46,300 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP = 89% of MP

⇒ 41207 = (89 ÷ 100) × MP

⇒ MP = (41207 × 100) ÷ 89

⇒ MP = 463 × 100

⇒ MP = 46300

**∴ The correct answer is 46300 (Option 4).**
